about: Every trading idea tested on this bot and the verdict. Out-of-sample walk-forward (train 180d / test 60d) on Upbit 4h data 2021-10..2026-10, fees 0.05% + slippage 0.05% per side, unless noted. Read this before proposing or testing an idea; re-test only if the data or the bot changed materially.
in_production: donchian + ema_cross, equal sub-accounts (steadier: positive quarters 42% -> 63%)
inverse-volatility weights across coins (MDD -6 to -8 pts)
fixed ATR stop + giveback guard: after +30% sell 15% below the high (Sharpe 1.15 -> 1.35; mostly 2024-12-03)
daily loss limit -5% and kill switch -35% per sleeve
weekly walk-forward re-selection of parameters; a sleeve stops new entries when it stopped working
real slippage learned from live fills feeds the weekly re-selection
self-review: add/drop one strategy only if better on old data AND not worse on the last 180 days; user approves

rejected.idea: break-even stop, 12% hard stop cap, wider stop grid
rejected.result: no gain or fails one half

rejected.idea: volatility cap 2.5%/day; all 4 strategies equal split
copying Wonyotti's BitMEX positions / imitation ML
meta-labeling: logistic filter on past trades (8 features)

rejected.result: Sharpe 1.80 but 1st half worse; gain came from one quarter via parameter path, not the gate. Watch, do not use
